🎥🎬: A Bug’s Life (1998)

Flik is an inventive but clumsy ant who accidentally destroys the food his colony has collected for a group of bullying grasshoppers led by the ruthless Hopper. When Hopper demands an even larger offering, Flik leaves the colony determined to find “warriors” who can protect them.

Flik returns with a group of circus bugs, mistakenly believing they are fearless fighters. When the truth is revealed, the insects must put aside their differences and stand together against Hopper and his gang. Flik’s inventions and determination ultimately inspire the colony to realize that they are stronger when they fight back together.

source_details.synopsis: A Bug's Life (stylized in all lowercase) is a 1998 American animated comedy film directed by John Lasseter and written by Andrew Stanton, Donald McEnery, and Bob Shaw. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, it stars the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Hayden Panettiere, Phyllis Diller, Richard Kind, David Hyde Pierce, Joe Ranft, and Denis Leary. In the film, a misfit anthropomorphic ant named Flik looks for "tough warriors" to save his ant colony from a protection racket run by a gang of grasshoppers. However, the "warriors" he brings back are a troupe of Circus Bugs. The film's plot was initially inspired by Aesop's fable The Ant and the Grass
